name: openai/gpt-5.2
description: GPT-5.2 is OpenAI's GPT-5 series flagship released in December 2025, positioned by OpenAI for complex professional work and long-running agents, with text and image input and text output. It offers configurable reasoning effort from none up to an extra-high setting, and OpenAI highlights its performance on well-specified knowledge work across dozens of occupations alongside coding and tool use. OpenAI now calls it a previous flagship, with GPT-5.4 following it.
